## Triage
1. `kubectl -n marketplace get pods -l app=$name` then `kubectl -n marketplace describe pod -l app=$name | tail -30` (probe failures, OOMKilled, image pull).
2. `kubectl -n marketplace logs deploy/$name --tail=200`: look for dependency errors from the list above.
3. Check the dependencies first (`kubectl -n marketplace get pods`), then this service.
4. Recent change? `kubectl -n argocd get application $name -o wide` and compare `images.$name` with the previous tag in git.
